conventions.problem_id:
surface////

; solid in tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron; mode fold (pieces may cross edges) or nofold (each piece in one closed face)
conventions.units: polygon pieces have side 1, disks (N = 0) radius 1
conventions.score: edge length s of the solid (smaller is better)
conventions.pose: face f and (x, y, theta) in f's frame: the regular M-gon of side s centred at the origin with a horizontal bottom edge; frame vertex k at angle -pi/2 + pi/M + 2 pi k/M is solids.json faces[f][k]; piece vertex k at angle theta + pi/2 + 2 pi k/N (radians)
conventions.certified_statement: pieces scaled by lam = 1 - eps about their centres at edge s are strictly valid (python/surface/cert.py); by similarity unit pieces fit at edge s / lam, so score_cert = s / lam rounded up to a float; display = score_cert rounded to 6 decimals (nearest, ties to even, from its exact binary64 value)
conventions.score_float: s, the edge of the stored configuration (pieces touching up to float rounding)
conventions.status: best_known everywhere (no published proofs); see notes for matches with the bound
